text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. I hope this year brings 
you lots of wonderful things too, Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks a bunch. Appreciate it. 
Having someone come at me so 
straightforward like that actually makes 
me feel kinda tickled.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... While I'm already feeling tickled, 
here's one more thing. Zephyr and I wrote 
a song together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A song, huh... A song!? Wait, you mean an 
original song?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Between Renga-hane-san's singing and 
a budding spring breeze that suits 
Nature-san so well... together, we 
finished a song blessed by a gentle wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure it turned out to be a great 
song...! It's warm and light... We talked 
all about Nature while writing it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A collaboration...!? F-For Nature-san's 
sake? You went out of your way to do that?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind listening? Later, I mean. 
If you're busy, I can work around your 
schedule, Nature-san...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... Is it really okay for me to 
accept something like this? It kinda goes 
way beyond a normal birthday gift from a 
classmate...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry. Was that a little too heavy...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No!! Just kidding, just kidding!! I'm 
crazy happy about it!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Ahh, I can't stop grinning. This 
is a bit beyond my capacity...
